summary: The filing is a Form 6-K disclosing a sales agreement for an at-the-market offering. Golden Heaven Group Holdings entered into a sales agreement with Craft Capital Management to sell up to $50 million of Class A ordinary shares under its existing F-3 shelf. The 5% agent commission and expense reimbursements are standard for an ATM program. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special-situations event. No board recommendation, premium, or structural complexities are involved. It represents ordinary course equity financing, so the appropriate classification is none.
